sections.description:
Dynamic Post automatically pulls fresh articles from Dynamicontent.net every month and lets you place them anywhere on your site with shortcodes.

Version 8.0 New Features
* Grok AI Content Writer – Generate unlimited custom SEO-optimized articles directly from the plugin settings using Grok AI.
* One-click article creation with length selection, category choice, and post status.
* + Create New Category on the spot – type a new category name and the plugin creates it automatically.
* Grok articles are treated as normal custom content (no Dynamic Post disclaimer).
* Full compatibility with Free and Full API keys (Grok tab grayed out on Free).
* Improved admin UI with clean Font Awesome 6 icons and restored WordPress Dashicons.
* Enhanced Category Posting Settings table with live API/Blog counts, Reads Now / Reads All, and version status.
* All previous features (Post From Start Date, RSS Feeds, Dynamic Content Install, shortcodes, archive, etc.) remain fully functional.

Key Features
* Auto-pulls current month articles on the 2nd at 2 AM your time
* Full API users get historical archive access and “Post From Start Date”
* RSS Feed support (up to 5 feeds) with hot-linked images
* Dynamic Content Install button for complete News & Tools section
* Shortcodes work on any page/post
* Free API shows all features (grayed out with upgrade link)
* Safe API handling with circuit breaker (no endless loops if API is down)

  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Dynamic Post → Settings and enter your API key
  4. Save Changes and start using the tabs

sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with newest WP version and also older versions?

Yes, this plugin works with WordPress 3.3 onwards!

What is API Pull Date?

Dynamic Post plugin will auto pull your selected article categories every month on the 2nd of that month at 2 AM your time.

How to use the API Key

Plugin Dashboard displays both the API Keys. Copy it from there and enter your Free/Full API Key in the API Key field and click “Save Changes”, wait while new setting load.

How to use Custom CSS

If you want to add your custom CSS you can write in the custom CSS field, click on “Save Changes”, and wait while the new setting loads.

What is Free Key?

The Free Key will only display the current months articles. If you want to accumulate articles over time and have images for a more expansive user experience and/or for SEO purposes, upgrade to the Full Version.

How to display single category articles in frontend

If you want to display the articles of a particular category on the website, select the category from the list by clicking on the checkbox and then click on Display Articles in Frontend button. This will add your Dynamic Post articles to your blog and save your choices for next month’s auto pull.

How to retrieve all category articles

If you want to retrieve the articles of all categories, select all categories from the list by clicking on the checkbox and then click on Display Articles in Frontend button to make the changes. This will add all Dynamic Post articles to your blog and saves your choices for next month’s auto pull.

How to remove and reload the articles

If you don’t want a particular article to display in your blog, you will need to go into Posts and move it to the Trash.

How to use Category Shortcode

If you want to display articles in a post/page, copy the category shortcode ( eg. [dynamic-post cat=”your_category_name”] ) and paste it in a post/page and save the changes.

How to use Archive Shortcode

If you want to display articles for a specific date, copy the archive shortcode ( eg. [dynamic-posts cat=”your_category_name” month=”month_name” year=”year”] ) and paste it in a post/page you want to display and save the changes.

6.01

New Features — Added “Post From Start Date” button next to the “Post Articles” button (Full API only). This allows site admins to retrieve old articles back to the start date listed in Article Display Settings.
Added “Post Version” column in the Article Display Settings table. It shows the current live version number from the API. If a newer version is available, it displays “Available” instead of a number.
Improved version number checking: the plugin now safely detects and replaces outdated articles with newer versions from the API. Shortcodes now properly handle both full category names and aliases for better compatibility.
Bug Fixes & Stability Improvements — Fixed critical fatal error on Free API sites (in_array(): Argument #2 must be of type array, string given). Fixed settings page crashing or showing as plain text (no layout) when the API returns partial or incomplete data. Made the settings page load reliably on both Free API and Full API sites.
Fixed saved category selection persistence (checkboxes now remember your last choices correctly).
Added safety handling so the plugin no longer breaks if the API response is missing expected fields.

7.0

Release Date – April 2026

New Major Feature – RSS Feed Support
– Added support for up to 5 RSS Feeds in the Blog Settings table.
– The plugin now automatically pulls current-month articles only from each RSS feed.
– Images and media are hot-linked (original URLs) — no files are imported into the WordPress Media Library.
– If a hot-link is blocked, the image simply does not display (graceful fallback).
– RSS posts use domain-based author and category (e.g., author = “bloomberg”, category = “Bloomberg”).
– All previous NEW features (API/Blog columns, page hit counts, Post From Start Date, version column, all-categories display, admin panel performance optimization, etc.) are included and fully stabilized.

Bug Fixes & Improvements
– Fixed “What’s New in Technology” (and other apostrophe categories) API/Blog count resetting to zero.
– RSS feed URLs no longer shift position after saving settings.
– Enhanced error logging and safeguards for RSS feeds (timeouts, empty responses, blocked feeds).
– All existing features (Free/Full API behavior, shortcodes, trash handling, disclaimers, saved categories, etc.) remain 100% unchanged.
*

8.0

  • Added full Grok AI Content Writer tab with one-click article generation
  • Added “Create New Category on the spot” feature
  • Fixed admin bar icons / Dashicons display
  • Updated Font Awesome to official v6 CDN
  • Improved category filtering (excludes Dynamic Post and RSS categories from Grok)
  • Enhanced UI and stability
